meta.name: baobab_village
meta.prompt: A village built in and around one colossal hollow baobab: the market inside its trunk, rope bridges from its branches to platform houses, ladders and lanterns up the bark.

programs.brief: A colossal ancient hollow baobab tree of immense girth. Its swollen wooden trunk is hollowed out into a multi-tiered bustling market chamber with stalls, counters, and timber archways; spiral stairs and carved ladders climb up the interior and exterior bark; massive horizontal boughs extend outward supporting hanging platform decks, rope bridge abutments, and glowing lantern clusters.
A stilt-mounted timber platform hut nestled in high tree boughs with a curved thatch awning, rope bridge stubs, hanging lanterns, and perimeter railing.

tokens.terrain: a warm, open savanna plain centered on one colossal ancient hollow baobab tree
tokens.icons: a lively village market sheltered inside the vast hollow trunk; wooden platform houses hung from high boughs; rope bridges spanning between canopy branches; winding ladders, walkways, and hanging lanterns ascending the outer bark
